classification.difficultyReason: Read marked angle arms and place the common vertex in the middle of each three-letter name.

spec.description: Two arrow-ended rays from Y through marked points X and Z; an arrowed acute arc turns from YZ towards YX.
spec.mathematics: Vertex Y; arms YX and YZ. Coordinates reconstruct appearance without asserting a numerical angle.
spec.answerVisibility: Given black arc visible; supplied angle names are answer-only.

answer.worked: The arms are $YX$ and $YZ$. Put the vertex $Y$ in the middle: $\angle XYZ$ or $\angle ZYX$.

spec.description: Leftward ray RS and rising rightward ray RQ, with marked S and Q and an arrowed obtuse arc ending near RS.
spec.mathematics: Vertex R; arms RS and RQ.
spec.answerVisibility: Given black arc visible; supplied angle names are answer-only.

answer.worked: The arms are $RS$ and $RQ$. Put the vertex $R$ in the middle: $\angle SRQ$ or $\angle QRS$.

spec.description: Ray KB runs left and slightly upward; ray KL runs steeply down and right. Marked points B and L; arrowed interior arc ends near KL.
spec.mathematics: Vertex K; obtuse sector between KB and KL.
spec.answerVisibility: Given black arc visible; supplied angle names are answer-only.

answer.worked: The arms are $KB$ and $KL$. Put the vertex $K$ in the middle: $\angle BKL$ or $\angle LKB$.

spec.description: Ray DC rises left; DE runs horizontally right. Marked C and E; arrowed obtuse arc ends near DC.
spec.mathematics: Vertex D; arms DC and DE.
spec.answerVisibility: Given black arc visible; supplied angle names are answer-only.

answer.worked: The arms are $DC$ and $DE$. Put the vertex $D$ in the middle: $\angle CDE$ or $\angle EDC$.

spec.description: Vertical segment VTS with three filled points, labels on the right and a left semicircle at T. No arrowheads.
spec.mathematics: TV and TS are opposite arms of a straight angle.
spec.answerVisibility: Given black semicircle visible; supplied angle names are answer-only.

answer.worked: The opposite arms are $TV$ and $TS$. Put the vertex $T$ in the middle: $\angle VTS$ or $\angle STV$.

spec.description: Ray GJ runs left; GE rises left. Marked J and E; arrowed acute arc ends near GJ.
spec.mathematics: Vertex G; arms GJ and GE.
spec.answerVisibility: Given black arc visible; supplied angle names are answer-only.

answer.worked: The arms are $GJ$ and $GE$. Put the vertex $G$ in the middle: $\angle JGE$ or $\angle EGJ$.
